annotation.title_clean: Focus of work of the Group of Governmental Experts in 2021 (Working paper on elements of a normative and operational framework on LAWS)
annotation.title_en: Focus of work of the Group of Governmental Experts in 2021 (Working paper on elements of a normative and operational framework on LAWS)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Argentina, Costa Rica, Ecuador, El Salvador, Panama, State of Palestine, Peru, Philippines, Sierra Leone and Eastern Republic (Uruguay) - submission to CCW GGE on LAWS
annotation.venue: UN CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS (CCW/GGE.1/2021/WP.7)
annotation.summary_en: Working paper by ten states to the CCW Group of Governmental Experts proposing normative and operational framework elements on lethal autonomous weapons: prohibit fully autonomous systems and those targeting humans, require meaningful human control, accountability and transparency, and negotiate a legally binding instrument.
key_provisions_or_claims: Fully autonomous weapons without meaningful human control must be prohibited under international law
Systems using target profiles against humans should be prohibited; other autonomous weapons regulated via limits on targets, duration, scope and situations
Meaningful human control throughout the lifecycle; accountability rests on humans, states and corporations
States should be transparent on development and weapons reviews; share good practices
Recommend a new GGE mandate to negotiate a legally binding instrument at the Sixth Review Conference
